'''Dream Cards''' is a [[GEMP]] format that adds GEMP's Dream Cards set to the [[Open]] card pool. It is not offered as a game hall format.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="lib" />

* '''Type:''' casual
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' the Open pool plus the Dream Cards set (GEMP set id 401)
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Dream Cards'' (<code>dream_cards</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

== Card pool ==
The format allows Decipher set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]), premium ids 101&ndash;112, current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301), plus the Dream Cards set (id 401).<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /> The definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

The public GEMP code sets the size of the Dream Cards set to 0 cards, so the format's pool is in practice the same as Open.<ref name="cardcounts" />

== History ==
The format is in the Players Committee GEMP code and in play.swccg.com with the same definition.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> No source says what the Dream Cards set was meant to hold, when the format was added, or who uses it. No tournament is known to have used it.
